checks.name: CK_VIS_OBS_OBSERVATION_VALUE
checks.expression:
(("sd_val_type" = 'STRING')
    AND ("value_string" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("cd_val_number" IS NULL)
    AND ("fg_val_boolean" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val" IS NULL)
    AND ("dt_val_dttm" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_val_type" = 'NUMBER')
    AND ("value_string" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val_number" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("fg_val_boolean" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val" IS NULL)
    AND ("dt_val_dttm" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_val_type" = 'BOOLEAN')
    AND ("value_string" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val_number" IS NULL)
    AND ("fg_val_boolean" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("cd_val" IS NULL)
    AND ("dt_val_dttm" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_val_type" = 'CODE')
    AND ("value_string" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val_number" IS NULL)
    AND ("fg_val_boolean" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("dt_val_dttm" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_val_type" = 'DATETIME')
    AND ("value_string" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val_number" IS NULL)
    AND ("fg_val_boolean" IS NULL)
    AND ("cd_val" IS NULL)
    AND ("dt_val_dttm" IS NOT NULL))
